blocks.html: Hypnotherapy is a safe and effective way to work with the Inner Child to enhance feelings of self-love, worthiness, self-esteem, confidence, sharing your gifts with the world, and so much more!
What is Hypnotherapy?

Hypnotherapy is a highly effective modality for accessing the unconscious mind.   The unconscious mind stores our memories, our habits and also the beliefs that we hold about ourselves and the world around us.   These beliefs are like a computer program and the unconscious mind works to make them a reality in our day-to-day experience.  Neuroscience has shown that most of our decisions, actions, emotions and behaviours depend on the 95 percent of brain activity that lies beyond conscious awareness, meaning that 95 percent of your life comes from the programming in your unconscious mind.

During a hypnotherapy session you will be guided into a Theta brain wave state (a state of deep relaxation).  When in this brainwave frequency the door to the unconscious mind is open and limiting or sabotaging beliefs can be replaced with those that will support you in creating the life that you desire.
Programming of the unconscious mind occurs before age Six
blocks.text: Programming of the unconscious mind occurs before age Six

blocks.html: The predominant brain activity during a child’s first two years of life is Delta, which is the lowest brain-wave frequency range. Between two and six years of age, a child’s brain activity increases and operates primarily in the range of Theta. While in this Theta state, children spend much of their time moving between the imaginary world with the real world. Delta and Theta brain frequencies define a brain state known as a Trance—the same brainwave state that hypnotherapists use to directly download new beliefs into the unconscious minds of their clients.

What this means is that the first 6 years of a child’s life are largely spent in a state of hypnotic trance!  During this time a child is downloading the opinions and beliefs of those around them about themselves and the world -  largely without a filter.  Is it any wonder that when we reach adulthood we find that many of the these beliefs do not serve us very well or in some cases are limiting or sabotaging.

blocks.text: A private retreat for powerful healing and genuine rest

blocks.html: The Restorative Healing Retreat is an intimate, entirely one-to-one retreat for those who want to experience powerful energy healing while also giving themselves the time, privacy and space to genuinely rest.

This is not an intensive transformational retreat. There is no packed schedule and no expectation that you spend every day working deeply on yourself. Instead, personalised energy healing is woven into a beautiful, private and deeply restorative Bali experience.

You will have your own private villa, nourishing gluten-free and celiac-safe food, two private massages, time beside the rice fields, personalised healing sessions and generous periods of completely unstructured time.
The philosophy - you do not have to choose between deep healing and deep rest. This retreat brings the two together — powerful healing work, followed by the space to receive, integrate and restore.
Who is this retreat for?

This retreat is for someone who knows they need time away from everyday demands and would like something deeper than a conventional wellness break — but who is not looking for an intensive transformational retreat.

items: You feel depleted, overstimulated or simply ready for a genuine pause.
You are curious about energy healing or already value energetic work.
You have done significant personal or spiritual work and want a more spacious experience this time.
You are moving through a transition, period of change or demanding chapter of life.
You want to be cared for rather than follow a demanding retreat schedule.
You want privacy, beautiful surroundings, nourishing food and meaningful healing in one experience.

blocks.html: Your private retreat experience

The retreat is held entirely one-to-one. Sharon is your lead practitioner and overall guide throughout the experience, supported by carefully selected team members where their particular expertise adds value.
There is a clear framework, but the retreat is never rigid. Your sessions and practices are tailored according to your intentions, your needs and what emerges as the retreat unfolds.

items: Private villa accommodation.
Airport pick-up on arrival and private airport transfer on departure.
Personalised one-to-one guidance with Sharon throughout the retreat.
Shamanic Energy Healing.
A personalised complementary healing session, selected from sound therapy, Reiki or breathwork according to your needs.
A personalised Energetic Blueprint session based on Vedic Astrology.

Personal reflection and integration time.
A carefully prepared welcome pack.

The retreat has a carefully designed arc, but the experience remains spacious. The time between sessions is not empty time — it is part of the retreat. You may sleep, swim, read, journal, walk through the rice fields or do nothing at all.

items: Pickup & private transfer from airport or wherever you are in Bali.

Welcome pack - includes a personal welcome letter from Sharon, retreat information, a journal and pen, intention-setting material, practical villa information and a small locally sourced gift.

Private introductory session with Sharon to explore where you are now, what has been demanding your attention, what you have been carrying and what would make this retreat genuinely valuable for you. Together we establish personal intentions that become a guiding thread for the days ahead.
Private time - generous unstructured time to sleep, swim, read, journal, walk or simply enjoy the surroundings.

The work may support releasing accumulated energetic and emotional weight, clearing what is no longer serving you and creating space for new energy, clarity and possibility.

You will be invited to complete a short pre-call questionnaire. If the experience appears suitable, we will schedule a private discovery call. From there, we create a personalised recommendation and proposal.

Most retreats ask you to join a group and follow a shared schedule.  The Next Chapter is private, spacious and personalised.  There are no large circles, no forced  sharing, no rigid timetable, nopressure to have a dramatic breakthrough and no requirement to identify as spiritual.
Instead, you are supported by experienced practitioners in a calm, private environment where reflection, healing and integration can unfold at the right pace.

blocks.html: There are times in life when the path ahead is no longer as clear as it once seemed.
You may be questioning your career, considering a major life change, navigating the end of a chapter, or simply sensing that something is asking for your attention.
From the outside, life may look successful.  From the inside, you may find yourself asking:

items: What comes next?
Is this still the life I want?
What am I moving towards?
What deserves my attention now?
How do I make sense of what I'm feeling?

blocks.html: You do not need to have the answers. You simply need a place to begin. Start Your Next Chapter is a structured one-to-one conversation designed to help you step back, reflect, and gain greater clarity about where you are and what may come next.
Who Is This For?
This session is for people experiencing change, uncertainty, transition, or a growing sense that life is inviting them in a new direction.  You may be:

items: Considering a career change or new professional direction
Transitioning out of a leadership, executive, or business role
Feeling successful on paper but uncertain about what comes next
Navigating a significant life event or personal crossroads
Exploring a different lifestyle, location, or way of working
Feeling stuck between competing priorities or possibilities
Looking for space to think without pressure, judgement, or advice

items: Where are you today?

What comes next?

items: Therapy or counselling

A personality assessment
A process where someone tells you what to do

blocks.html: The story starts back around the year 2010, Sharon Marie was living in Australia and studying Ayurvedic Medicine with one of the most respected Ayurveda teachers on the planet. Ayurveda is a 5000 year-old system of knowledge that teaches us that everyone has a unique and different body and mind constitution, what is referred to as your prakruti or body-mind blueprint. This explains why many wellbeing hacks don't always work for everyone. ​Rather than fixing symptoms, real solutions require addressing underlying root causes of concerns.

With a successful wellbeing practice already operating in Australia, a visit to Ubud in 2015 led to the idea of moving the business to Bali.  This dream became a reality in 2018 with the establishment of PT The Juicy Effect.

This is why we combine a carefully selected variety of ancient and modern techniques that are highly effective for clearing, balancing and restoring energy. We call it energy healing.

Shamanic Energy Healing, Vedic Astrology, Hypnotherapy for Inner Child Healing, Access Bars Energy Healing, Breathwork, Ayurveda, Kinesiology, Sound Healing and more. The value we provide is that we have spent countless hours interpreting and integrating these various disciplines to get the best results.

blocks.html: Did you know that the World Health Organisation recently added burnout to their list of Classification Of International Diseases - described as a syndrome conceptualised as resulting from chronic workplace stress that has not been successfully managed. The great news is that Ubud is the perfect place to pause, press the reset button, and get your health back on track! It’s a magical place that derives its name from a Balinese word that means ‘medicine’, attracting people from all over the world who seek out transformation for body, mind and spirit.  Whether you stay for a week or many months, everything’s already here to build your own DIY mix-and-match recovery retreat.

Of course whilst you are in Ubud, remember to book in to see us here at The Juicy Effect!  Whether it’s to discover your unique body-mind type, balance your body’s energy system or experience what shamanic energy healing is all about, we’d love to make your ubud experience even better.
Create your own retreat.

Located only an hour’s drive from Bali’s main international airport, Ubud is amazingly safe for all travelers. There is plenty of accommodation to suit every budget, from traditional homestays to amazing six-star hotels (yes, there is a 6 star hotel in Ubud!), and everything in between.  You can start your day with a Yoga or Meditation class at any number of wonderful studios, attend any number of therapies including massage, sound healing, salt-water floating, and reiki just to name a few.  There’s site seeing tours, temples and waterfalls to discover, or get adventurous with a quadbike, cycling or rafting tour.  And then there’s the amazing choice of high-quality restaurants to suit different every taste and budget (there’s over 700 restaurants in Ubud alone!).

Oh, of course there’s also the chance to relax, write that book, study, and take in a few workshops.  It’s your Ubud retreat, you get to create it!  You may even just make it up as you go once you get here, more and more of our first-time customers are doing exactly this!
There’s Yoga Studios (we drop into these classes regularly)
blocks.text: There’s Yoga Studios (we drop into these classes regularly)

blocks.html: The Yoga Barn. With over 140 classes per week, a healthy cafe and a selection of therapies, Yoga Barn is a major attraction in Ubud and arguably Ubud’s first Yoga studio. It’s Instagram paradise (if you like that sort of thing)! Visit www.theyogabarn.com.

Radiantly Alive. Just refurbished with a range of new classes and events, this is also somewhere we go ourselves on a regular basis. High quality instructors and down to earth vibe. Visit www.radiantlyalive.com
The Ubud Yoga Centre. With amazing scenery and a location away from the hustle and bustle of the main centre, Ubud Yoga Centre has an impressive selection of classes. Visit www.ubudyogacentre.c om

Alchemy Yoga & Meditation Centre. Alchemy started as a small restaurant back in the day, and has blossomed into one of Bali’s best yoga centres. With great instructors and a wonderful vibe, it’s certainly worth visiting. www.alchemyyogacenter.com
There’s restaurants for vegetarians
Unity Cafe Bali. Ubud’s newest 100% gluten-free vegetarian cafe is right out the front of our property, and it is amazing! come and try for yourself.
Garden Cafe (Yoga Barn). They do have fish and chicken on the menu, but vegetarians will love this place. It is great to eat and hang out.
Seeds Of Life. Part of the raw food revolution. Sharon orders from here regularly and it is awesome. Even Jason loves it! They are also now in Penestanan.
Clear Cafe. This is an Ubud institution, and deserves the praise. There is a decent menu that includes fish dishes for those who don’t want total Vege.

Sayuri Healing Food. This place is always busy for a reason, it’s great! Look out for their daily specials as well as their cooking classes. It’s definitely worth a visit even if just to experience once.

And there are plenty of things to do, including immersing yourself in the Pyramids of Chi Sound Healing experience, meandering through rice field walks (we have one just around the corner from us), and visiting water temples.  Of course, you can also enjoy what Ubud is best known for, relaxing.

blocks.html: Jyotish, otherwise known as Vedic Astrology, is from the same family of knowledge as Yoga and Ayurveda.  It translates into English as the word ‘flame’ and it’s purpose is to help shine a light on undiscovered strengths, characteristics, challenges, unconscious habits and opportunities for transformation.
Why Vedic Astrology?

Vedic Astrology has been practiced for thousands of years as a way of helping people to understand, discover and choose constructive pathways. It is based on one of the secrets of the connected universe - that whatever is born or created at a particular moment of time inherits the qualities of that moment in time. At the moment of your birth, there are unique energetic influences that shape your subconscious habits, tendencies and preferences. By shining a light on these tendencies and patterns, and understanding the subtle forces that influence your outlook on life, you will be able to make constructive choices for health, career, relationships, financial matters, family (and more).

paras: By understanding how you got to this point and why you made the choices you made, you can choose to make more informed choices into the future. This is the basis of transformation.

Even twins can have different preferences. It’s very different to the type of Astrology that assumes everyone born in the same sign between certain dates will have the same characteristics (my teachers call this entertainment rather than Astrology). After searching for many years to find a system of knowledge that can help to understand human personality, Vedic Astrology has never let us down.

Here’s the answers to other frequently asked questions…
Is Womb Alchemy right for me if I have not done deep healing work before?

Yes. Womb Alchemy is held with reverence and care, and the pacing across three months gives your nervous system the room it needs to adjust. The preparation videos and the gentle structure of each session create a safe entry point if this is new territory. If you are already an experienced practitioner, the work goes as deep as you allow it to.
What if I cannot make a scheduled session date?
All three sessions are scheduled together at the start, with flexibility built in. If life shifts, we will reschedule. This journey is yours to receive in your own timing, not on a rigid calendar.
I am not in Bali. Is the energy healing as effective at a distance?

Yes. All three sessions are delivered online and the energy healing component works through resonance rather than physical proximity. Distance healing has a long lineage in shamanic and energetic traditions. Many of our most profound transformations have come from women on the other side of the world.
How is this different from therapy?

Therapy works primarily through cognition and language. Womb Alchemy works through ceremony, somatic awareness, ancestral resonance and energetic clearing. The two complement each other beautifully. This work is not a replacement for mental health care, particularly if you are currently in active crisis, but it reaches places that talk based modalities often cannot.
What support do I have between sessions?

After each live session you receive a personalised voice note transmission with reflections, integration guidance and energetic support. Before each session, a preparation video grounds you in somatic practices that open and steady the womb space. You are not left alone between initiations.
Can I do this if I am pregnant, postpartum, in menopause, or have had a hysterectomy?

Yes. The womb is an energetic space that exists regardless of your physical reproductive status, and we adapt the work depending on where you are in your cycle of life. If you have specific medical or somatic concerns, please reach out before enrolling so we can talk it through.

blocks.html: Step away from the demands of everyday life and enter a deeply personal journey of release, reclamation and embodied sovereignty.
There are moments in life when something within us knows that we cannot continue exactly as we have before.

Perhaps you are moving through a significant transition. Perhaps you have spent years caring for others, holding everything together, giving your energy away, or living according to expectations that no longer feel like your own. Perhaps you simply know that a deeper part of you is ready to emerge.
The Womb Sovereign is an invitation to step away from the noise of everyday life and return to yourself.
This is not a group retreat. There is no packed schedule, no need to perform your transformation in front of other people, and no expectation that every moment of your day should be filled.
This is a private, one-to-one experience created around you — your needs, your intentions, your energetic landscape and the woman you are becoming.

Held in the beautiful surroundings of Ubud, Bali, you will stay in an exclusive private villa on site and be personally guided through a transformational journey centred around the Divine Feminine, the Womb, feminine wisdom, protection, self-trust, inner authority and sovereignty.

At the heart of the retreat is a three-part Womb Healing journey: Womb of the Ancients, Meeting the Womb Guardian, and Embodying the Inner Queen. Each journey combines a guided Shamanic Vision Quest with a hands-on energy healing session. The journeys are intentionally prepared for through somatic practices and guided inner work, and followed by dedicated journal prompts and spacious integration time.

The retreat also includes a separate Shamanic Energy Healing session, private mentoring with Sharon, nourishing vegetarian and gluten-free breakfast and lunch from Unity Cafe, two massages in the privacy of your villa, an opening ceremony, a closing ceremony, time in nature and generous space to rest, reflect and simply be.

The intention is not to give you more to do. It is to create enough space for you to listen deeply — to your body, your intuition, your womb, your inner knowing and the part of you that may already know what is ready to change.
The Transformational Arc

items: OPEN — arriving, crossing the threshold and setting your intention.
RETURN — reconnecting with the Womb through the Womb of the Ancients.
PROTECT — meeting the Womb Guardian and exploring boundaries, discernment and embodied safety.
RECLAIM — reconnecting with the Inner Queen and the capacity to choose, lead and trust yourself.
EMBODY — integrating the work and translating the experience into practical tools for life at home.

blocks.html: The three journeys are Womb of the Ancients, Meeting the Womb Guardian and Embodying the Inner Queen.
1 - The Womb

In Womb Alchemy, the womb is approached as a multidimensional portal and a centre of feminine power, sovereignty, intuition, creation and receiving. The work honours both the natural power of the womb and the experiences that may have been held there — including learned emotional patterns, relationship experiences, breaches of boundaries, grief, fear, shame, guilt and experiences of disempowerment, as well as what may have travelled through the ancestral line.
2 - The Womb Guardian

The Womb Guardian represents the part of your energetic blueprint that knows what feels safe and what does not. She stands at the threshold. She senses what is allowed in, when to open, when to soften and when to hold a boundary. The work is not about getting rid of protection, but about reconnecting with this intelligence and restoring a clearer, more balanced relationship with your own yes and no.
3 - The Inner Queen

The Inner Queen is not something you become; she is something you remember. She is a state of embodied self-trust — a way of leading your life from grounded inner knowing rather than pressure, proving or the need for approval. Where the Guardian governs access, the Queen governs direction. The Guardian stands at the gate; the Queen sits on the throne.

FAQs
Is this a retreat?
Not in the usual sense. Womb Sovereign is private, personalised and designed around your needs. There are no group activities, fixed retreat timetable or requirement to share with strangers.
Do I need to be spiritual?
blocks.text: Do I need to be spiritual?

blocks.html: No. Many guests are spiritually curious, but no particular belief system is required.  At The Juicy Effect, we combine the best from what works from a range of disciplines.
Can my partner come with me?
blocks.text: Can my partner come with me?

blocks.html: Yes, depending on the situation.  The accommodation is a private villa and it is possible for a partner to be part of the accommodation.
What happens after I enquire?

You will be invited to complete a short pre-call questionnaire. If the experience appears suitable, we will schedule a private discovery call. From there, we create a personalised recommendation and proposal.
What makes this different?

Most retreats ask you to join a group and follow a shared schedule.  The Next Chapter is private, spacious and personalised.  There are no large circles, no forced  sharing, no rigid timetable, nopressure to have a dramatic breakthrough and no requirement to identify as spiritual.
Instead, you are supported by experienced practitioners in a calm, private environment where reflection, healing and integration can unfold at the right pace.
